description: Validate or create a concept map or Futures Wheel. Set graph.graph_type explicitly. Wheels require causal parent/order metadata and use the same radial geometry as the editor; only radial layout is allowed. Wheel creation follows the existing admin rollout switch. Concept maps: Specify requested layout only as top-level graph.layout_intent. When omitted, requested_layout and resolved_strategy are smart, but [0,0] placeholders are retained for the map client to lay out on first draw; layout_application is client-first-draw. Complete explicit coordinates are preserved instead. Set validate_only=true to check the exact final graph schema, layout, capacity, links, and credits without creating a map, charging credits, or reserving the idempotency key. For credit-bearing creation, show the quoted charge, then confirm the retained draft only after explicit approval.

semantic_data.description: Knowledge/concept maps do not expose Evidence and classification fields. Do not ask users for or invent semantic roles, node tags, relationship type, basis/assertion status, review status, supporting evidence, or source-reference classifications for concept maps. Use clear labels, node descriptions and resource links for context and sources. Existing semantic metadata remains supported for compatibility: preserve it when editing, without adding classification defaults. Structural metadata such as grouping and map links remains supported. Futures Wheel evidence controls and typed causal metadata are unchanged.

graph_type.description: Choose a graph type explicitly. Futures wheels require exactly one order-0 center, parent_id/order metadata on every consequence, and causal edges forming one tree through five orders. Only radial layout is supported for wheels.

layout_intent.description: Requested semantic layout. Use this exact top-level field. If omitted, KnowMapped automatically applies Smart layout unless every node supplies explicit x/y coordinates; complete explicit coordinates are preserved as manual positioning. For futures_wheel the default is radial, positions are always derived, and non-radial intent is rejected.

semantic_data.description: Knowledge/concept maps do not expose Evidence and classification fields. Do not ask users for or invent semantic roles, node tags, relationship type, basis/assertion status, review status, supporting evidence, or source-reference classifications for concept maps. Use clear labels, node descriptions and resource links for context and sources. Existing semantic metadata remains supported for compatibility: preserve it when editing, without adding classification defaults. Structural metadata such as grouping and map links remains supported. Futures Wheel evidence controls and typed causal metadata are unchanged. For futures_wheel: futures_wheel.order is 0 for the unique center or 1–5 for consequences; futures_wheel.parent_id is null for the center, otherwise the source node ID. Center futures_wheel.domains contains up to 32 {id,label} entries; only order 1 may set domain_id. collapsed is a boolean beside futures_wheel. status is possible/assumption/evidence (not a fact check).

presentation.description: Non-layout visual settings. Layout belongs in top-level layout_intent.
